techniques.summary_verbatim: We show that guidance can be indeed performed by a pure generative model without such a classifier: in what we call classifier-free guidance, we jointly train a conditional and an unconditional diffusion model, and we combine the resulting conditional and unconditional score estimates to attain a trade-off between sample quality and diversity similar to that obtained using classifier guidance.
mechanism_atoms: Jointly trains one model on both conditional (with label/text) and unconditional (label dropped randomly) objectives
At sampling time, the score estimate is extrapolated: s = s_unconditional + w * (s_conditional - s_unconditional)
The guidance scale w controls quality-diversity tradeoff: larger w yields higher fidelity but less diversity
Eliminates the need to train a separate classifier on noisy images, simplifying the pipeline
Adopted as standard technique in DALL-E 3, Imagen, and flow-matching based models

techniques.name: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
techniques.capability_it_enables: Training continuous normalizing flows at scale with simple regression
techniques.summary_verbatim: We introduce a new paradigm for generative modeling built on Continuous Normalizing Flows (CNFs), allowing us to train CNFs at unprecedented scale.
mechanism_atoms: Defines a conditional probability path between noise and data distributions (e.g., Gaussian to data distribution)
Trains a neural network to regress the vector field of these fixed conditional probability paths — no simulation needed
At inference, integrates the learned vector field using an ODE solver to transport noise to data samples
Optimal Transport (OT) displacement interpolation defines straighter paths, improving efficiency over diffusion paths
Subsumes existing diffusion paths as special cases while enabling non-diffusion, potentially faster paths

techniques.name: Sparse Autoencoders for Mechanistic Interpretability
techniques.capability_it_enables: Decomposing polysemantic neural network activations into monosemantic features
techniques.summary_verbatim: These autoencoders learn sets of sparsely activating features that are more interpretable and monosemantic than directions identified by alternative approaches, with interpretability measured by automated methods.
mechanism_atoms: Trains an overcomplete autoencoder (more hidden units than input dimensions) on internal model activations
Enforces sparsity via an L1 penalty on the hidden layer activations so only a few features activate per input
Each feature in the overcomplete dictionary corresponds to a (hopefully) monosemantic concept
Superposition — where neurons encode multiple concepts — is resolved by the overcomplete sparse basis
Features can be causally validated via ablation/patching on downstream tasks like indirect object identification

techniques.name: Activation Patching / Causal Tracing (ROME)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Locating and surgically editing factual knowledge stored in transformer layers
techniques.summary_verbatim: We analyze the storage and recall of factual associations in autoregressive transformer language models, finding evidence that these associations correspond to localized, directly-editable computations.
mechanism_atoms: Causal tracing: runs three forward passes — clean, corrupted (noisy subject tokens), and corrupted-then-restored — to find which activations are causally decisive
Identifies middle-layer feed-forward modules as the primary sites mediating factual association recall
ROME edits factual associations by computing a rank-one update to the weight matrix of a target feed-forward layer
The weight update is derived to satisfy two constraints: the new key-value association and preservation of existing associations
Evaluated on zsRE task and a new counterfactual benchmark showing specificity and generalization

techniques.name: Probing Classifiers for Representation Interpretability
techniques.capability_it_enables: Testing whether specific linguistic properties are encoded in model representations
techniques.summary_verbatim: Probing classifiers have emerged as one of the prominent methodologies for interpreting and analyzing deep neural network models of natural language processing.
mechanism_atoms: Freeze the target model's weights; extract intermediate layer representations for a labeled dataset
Train a simple (often linear) classifier on top of the frozen representations to predict a linguistic property
High classifier accuracy is interpreted as evidence that the property is linearly encoded in that layer
Probing across multiple layers reveals where in the network specific information emerges and is discarded
Methodological limitations: probe accuracy can reflect the probe's own capacity rather than the representation; control tasks and mutual information probes address this

techniques.name: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
techniques.capability_it_enables: Interleaved reasoning traces and tool actions for grounded LLM agents
techniques.summary_verbatim: We explore the use of LLMs to generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner, allowing for greater synergy between the two: reasoning traces help the model induce, track, and update action plans as well as handle exceptions, while actions allow it to interface with external sources, such as knowledge bases or environments, to gather additional information.
mechanism_atoms: The LM generates alternating 'thought' tokens (free-form reasoning) and 'action' tokens (executable tool calls) in a single sequence
Action outputs (observations) are appended back to the context, grounding subsequent reasoning steps
Few-shot prompting with example thought-action-observation trajectories teaches the pattern
Overcomes chain-of-thought hallucination by grounding reasoning in retrieved facts from Wikipedia API or environment feedback
Outperforms both pure chain-of-thought and pure acting baselines on HotpotQA, Fever, ALFWorld, and WebShop

techniques.name: Tree of Thoughts (ToT)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Systematic exploration of reasoning paths with backtracking for hard planning tasks
techniques.summary_verbatim: ToT allows LMs to perform deliberate decision making by considering multiple different reasoning paths and self-evaluating choices to decide the next course of action, as well as looking ahead or backtracking when necessary to make global choices.
mechanism_atoms: Represents problem solving as a tree where each node is a 'thought' (coherent partial solution)
The LM generates multiple candidate thoughts at each step, expanding multiple branches in parallel
A value function (either the LM itself or a separate evaluator) scores each partial solution to guide search
Standard tree search algorithms (BFS or DFS) are used to traverse the thought tree and prune unpromising paths
Enables backtracking when a branch fails, avoiding left-to-right greedy errors of chain-of-thought

techniques.name: Constitutional AI (CAI)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Training harmless AI assistants via AI-generated critiques without human harm labels
techniques.summary_verbatim: As AI systems become more capable, we would like to enlist their help to supervise other AIs.
mechanism_atoms: Supervised phase: the model generates an initial response, critiques it against a constitutional principle, and revises; the revised response is used for SFT fine-tuning
The constitution is a list of human-authored principles (e.g., 'avoid harmful content'); no human harm labels are needed

RL phase (RLAIF): the fine-tuned model generates response pairs, an AI evaluator picks the better one per constitutional principles, and a preference model is trained on these AI-generated comparisons
The preference model is used as a reward signal for PPO-based RL fine-tuning
Reduces reliance on human feedback for harmlessness training while making the alignment target explicit and auditable

techniques.name: Process Reward Models (PRM) — Let's Verify Step by Step
techniques.capability_it_enables: Supervising each reasoning step in mathematical problem solving
techniques.summary_verbatim: We conduct our own investigation, finding that process supervision significantly outperforms outcome supervision for training models to solve problems from the challenging MATH dataset.
mechanism_atoms: Outcome Reward Models (ORM) provide a single reward at the final answer; PRMs assign a reward to each intermediate reasoning step
Human annotators label each step of a solution as correct or incorrect, producing step-level feedback signals
A PRM is trained to predict step-level correctness given the problem and the solution prefix up to that step
Best-of-n selection using PRM to rank candidate solutions achieves 78.2% on MATH vs. 69.6% for majority voting
Active learning significantly improves data efficiency: annotation effort is focused on uncertain steps

techniques.name: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute
techniques.capability_it_enables: Improving LLM performance on hard prompts by allocating more inference-time computation
techniques.summary_verbatim: Enabling LLMs to improve their outputs by using more test-time computation is a critical step towards building generally self-improving agents that can operate on open-ended natural language.
mechanism_atoms: Studies two main approaches: (1) search against a verifier/PRM using beam search or best-of-n over many generated solutions; (2) adaptive compute methods that modify the model's reasoning process per prompt
Finds that optimally scaling test-time compute can outperform a model 14x larger in parameter count on difficult prompts
Proposes a difficulty-adaptive compute allocation strategy: harder prompts receive more parallel samples or longer reasoning chains
Uses a process reward model (PRM) to guide best-of-n selection and beam search over partial solutions
Demonstrates a compute-optimal frontier: for a fixed FLOPs budget, test-time scaling can be more efficient than scaling model size

techniques.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Grounding language model generation in retrieved external knowledge
techniques.summary_verbatim: We explore a general-purpose fine-tuning recipe for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) -- models which combine pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation.
mechanism_atoms: A dense retriever (DPR-based) encodes both queries and documents into vector representations; retrieval finds the top-K documents for a query
Retrieved documents are prepended to the input context of a seq2seq generator (BART)
Two variants: RAG-Token marginalizes retrieved documents per output token; RAG-Sequence uses one document per output sequence
The retriever and generator are trained end-to-end with the MIPS index held fixed
Non-parametric memory (index) can be updated without retraining the model, enabling knowledge updates

techniques.name: DreamerV3: World Model-Based RL
techniques.capability_it_enables: General-purpose RL across diverse domains using a learned world model
techniques.summary_verbatim: DreamerV3 is a general algorithm that outperforms specialized methods across over 150 diverse tasks, with a single configuration.
mechanism_atoms: Learns a Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) world model from experience: encodes observations to categorical representations, predicts next states and rewards
Actor-critic policy is trained entirely from imagined rollouts inside the world model — no real environment interaction during policy update
World model training, behavior learning from imagined data, and environment data collection alternate each training step
Uses symlog transformations of returns and free bits in KL loss for stable learning across different reward scales
Is the first algorithm to collect diamonds in Minecraft from scratch without human data or curricula

techniques.name: Count-Based Exploration and Intrinsic Motivation (Pseudo-Counts)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Exploration in high-dimensional RL problems via density-model-derived pseudo-counts
techniques.summary_verbatim: We use density models to measure uncertainty, and propose a novel algorithm for deriving a pseudo-count from an arbitrary density model.
mechanism_atoms: Classical count-based exploration provides bonus reward proportional to 1/sqrt(N(s)) where N(s) is visit count — effective only in tabular settings

Replaces true counts with pseudo-counts derived from a density model: trains a density model on observations, pseudo-count is estimated from the density model's update magnitude when processing a state
Intrinsic reward = exploration bonus proportional to 1/sqrt(pseudo-count(s))
Applied to raw Atari pixel observations, enabling generalization of count-based exploration to deep RL
Achieves major progress on Montezuma's Revenge, a hard exploration game, where vanilla DQN scores near zero

techniques.name: Tool Use / Function Calling in LLM Agents
techniques.capability_it_enables: Enabling LLMs to call external APIs, calculators, and databases during inference
techniques.summary_verbatim: While actions allow it to interface with external sources, such as knowledge bases or environments, to gather additional information.
mechanism_atoms: LLM is provided with a schema of available tools (function name, parameters, description) in the context
Model generates a structured tool-call token sequence (e.g., JSON function call) indicating which tool to invoke with what arguments
Tool output is appended to the context as an 'observation' and the model continues generation
Models can be fine-tuned on tool-call demonstrations to improve reliability of call formatting
Enables LLMs to overcome knowledge cutoffs and perform precise computations they cannot do in weights alone

techniques.name: Intrinsic Curiosity / Random Network Distillation (RND) Exploration
techniques.capability_it_enables: Exploration driven by prediction error of a random neural network as novelty signal
techniques.summary_verbatim: Count-based exploration methods provide intrinsic rewards by measuring the novelty of states, defined to be inversely proportional to the state visitation counts.
mechanism_atoms: A fixed randomly-initialized target network maps states to embeddings; a predictor network is trained to match these embeddings
Prediction error on a new state serves as the intrinsic reward — states rarely visited yield high errors
As the predictor trains on visited states, their prediction error drops, reducing their intrinsic reward over time
The random target network ensures that the bonus is sensitive only to state novelty, not task-specific features
Combined with extrinsic rewards in a two-headed value function for scalable exploration

techniques.name: Denoising Score Matching / Score-Based Generative Models
techniques.capability_it_enables: Generative modeling by estimating the score (gradient of log-density) of data
techniques.summary_verbatim: Our best results are obtained by training on a weighted variational bound designed according to a novel connection between diffusion probabilistic models and denoising score matching with Langevin dynamics.
mechanism_atoms: The score function ∇_x log p(x) is estimated by training a neural network to predict the noise added to data (denoising score matching)
Multiple noise levels are used during training (noise conditional score network — NCSN), allowing the model to learn scores at varying scales
Sampling uses annealed Langevin dynamics: runs stochastic gradient ascent on log p starting from high noise, gradually reducing noise
Connection to diffusion models: the DDPM training objective is equivalent to a reweighted denoising score matching loss
Enables generation of continuous distributions without normalizing constant estimation

techniques.name: Reward Model Training via Bradley-Terry Preference Model
techniques.capability_it_enables: Converting pairwise human preference comparisons into scalar reward signals
techniques.summary_verbatim: Reward models (RMs) are essential for aligning large language models (LLM) with human expectations.
mechanism_atoms: Human annotators compare two model outputs and indicate which is preferred; these comparisons form the training data
The Bradley-Terry model parameterizes the probability that output A is preferred over B as σ(r(A) - r(B))
A neural network reward model is trained with binary cross-entropy on these pairwise preference labels
The reward model is then used as a proxy for human preferences during RL policy optimization (PPO)
Reward model quality directly determines RLHF policy quality; reward overoptimization occurs when the policy exploits reward model errors

techniques.name: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
techniques.capability_it_enables: Eliciting multi-step reasoning from LLMs via intermediate reasoning traces
techniques.summary_verbatim: We explore how generating a chain of thought -- a series of intermediate reasoning steps -- significantly improves the ability of large language models to perform complex reasoning.
mechanism_atoms: Augments few-shot prompts with worked-out step-by-step solutions rather than just answer labels
The model learns to produce intermediate reasoning tokens before the final answer by in-context imitation
Emergent capability: CoT gains are largest in models above ~100B parameters
Zero-shot variant ('Let's think step by step') triggers chain-of-thought without examples
Improves performance on arithmetic, symbolic reasoning, and commonsense reasoning benchmarks

techniques.name: Best-of-N Sampling (Inference-Time Scaling via Rejection Sampling)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Improving answer quality by generating multiple samples and selecting the best
techniques.summary_verbatim: If using the PRM to select the final output from candidate responses, a test accuracy of 78.2% can be achieved, compared to the ORM with 72.4% and majority voting of 69.6%.
mechanism_atoms: Generate N independent samples (candidate responses) from the LM for a given prompt
Score each candidate using a reward model, verifier, or PRM
Return the highest-scoring candidate as the final answer
Compute cost scales linearly with N; gains in accuracy scale sub-linearly (typically ~log N) with N
Serves as a simple but strong baseline for inference-time compute scaling studies

techniques.name: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) for LLMs
techniques.capability_it_enables: Scaling model capacity without proportional compute increase via conditional computation
techniques.summary_verbatim: MoE models achieve higher effective capacity by only activating a sparse subset of parameters for each token, enabling large total parameter counts at modest FLOPs per token.
mechanism_atoms: Replaces dense feed-forward layers with N parallel 'expert' FFNs and a gating network
A router network outputs softmax weights over experts; only the top-K experts (K<<N) are activated per token
Only activated experts compute and receive gradients for each token — sparse conditional computation
Load balancing auxiliary loss encourages equal expert utilization to prevent expert collapse
Enables models like Mixtral and DeepSeek-MoE to have 8x or more parameters while keeping per-token FLOPs constant

techniques.name: Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Scalable alignment using AI-generated preference labels instead of human labels
techniques.summary_verbatim: In the RL phase, we sample from the finetuned model, use a model to evaluate which of the two samples is better, and then train a preference model from this dataset of AI preferences.
mechanism_atoms: An AI judge model (typically a capable LM) evaluates pairs of outputs and produces preference labels according to specified principles
These AI-generated preference labels replace human annotations in the preference model training pipeline
Dramatically reduces human labeling cost while maintaining alignment quality competitive with human feedback
The constitutional principles guiding the AI judge make the target behavior explicit and auditable
RLAIF preference model is trained via standard Bradley-Terry loss and used as reward signal in PPO

techniques.name: Scaling Test-Time Compute via Beam Search + PRM
techniques.capability_it_enables: Guided multi-step reasoning search using process reward models
techniques.summary_verbatim: Answering this question has implications not only on the achievable performance of LLMs, but also on the future of LLM pretraining and how one should tradeoff inference-time and pre-training compute.
mechanism_atoms: Beam search maintains a beam of B partial solutions at each reasoning step
A PRM scores each partial solution at each step, used as the beam selection criterion
Beam expands by sampling multiple next steps from the LM for each beam element, then prunes to top-B by PRM score
Terminates when all beams reach a final answer; highest-PRM-scored complete solution is returned
Achieves better compute efficiency than best-of-n for fixed inference budgets on hard math problems

techniques.name: Model-Based RL with Imagined Rollouts (Dyna-style)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Sample-efficient RL by augmenting real experience with model-generated simulated transitions
techniques.summary_verbatim: Dreamer learns a model of the environment and improves its behavior by imagining future scenarios.
mechanism_atoms: A world model (RSSM) is trained on real environment transitions to predict next states, rewards, and done signals
The policy is updated entirely from synthetic rollouts imagined by the world model, without querying the real environment
Short imagined rollout horizons (e.g., 15 steps) prevent compounding model errors
Actor-critic trained on imagined data; critic bootstraps value estimates from the model's predicted rewards
Real data is periodically collected from the environment to update the world model, alternating with imagination-based policy updates

techniques.name: Mamba-3
techniques.capability_it_enables: Improved state-space-model LLM backbone: a more expressive (trapezoidal) recurrence, a complex-valued state-update rule for richer state tracking, and a MIMO formulation that boosts downstream accuracy without increasing decode latency; matches Mamba-2 perplexity with half the state size.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles Through Structured State Space Duality
mechanism_atoms: Improved state-space-model LLM backbone: a more expressive (trapezoidal) recurrence, a complex-valued state-update rule for richer state tracking, and a MIMO formulation that boosts downstream accuracy without increasing decode latency; matches Mamba-2 perplexity with half the state size.

techniques.name: Gated DeltaNet-2
techniques.capability_it_enables: Linear-attention sequence layer that decouples erase and write into two independent channel-wise gates, letting the model edit its fixed-size recurrent (compressed KV) memory without scrambling existing associations; trainable on FineWeb-Edu with released code.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Linear attention compresses an unbounded KV cache into a fixed-size recurrent state. The hard part is not just what to forget, but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations.
mechanism_atoms: Linear-attention sequence layer that decouples erase and write into two independent channel-wise gates, letting the model edit its fixed-size recurrent (compressed KV) memory without scrambling existing associations; trainable on FineWeb-Edu with released code.

techniques.name: MiniCPM-SALA
techniques.subfield: Efficient sequence architectures / hybrid sparse-linear attention
techniques.capability_it_enables: 9B hybrid LLM that interleaves sparse attention (InfLLM-V2) with linear attention (Lightning Attention) at a 1:3 ratio plus hybrid positional encoding, enabling million-token-context inference on consumer GPUs; converts pretrained Transformers to the hybrid via continual training (~75% cheaper than from scratch). Open weights released.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Integrates 25% InfLLM-V2 and 75% Lightning Attention, effectively leveraging the granular focus of sparse attention for local details and the high efficiency of linear attention for broad context.
mechanism_atoms: 9B hybrid LLM that interleaves sparse attention (InfLLM-V2) with linear attention (Lightning Attention) at a 1:3 ratio plus hybrid positional encoding, enabling million-token-context inference on consumer GPUs; converts pretrained Transformers to the hybrid via continual training (~75% cheaper than from scratch). Open weights released.

techniques.name: Parallax (Parameterized Local Linear Attention)
techniques.capability_it_enables: A drop-in upgrade to softmax attention: a scalable, solver-free form of Local Linear Attention that learns a query-like projector probing the KV covariance, with a hardware-aware decode kernel matching/outperforming FlashAttention 2/3; pretrained at 0.6B and 1.7B with consistent perplexity gains.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Parallax is an upgrade to Softmax Attention. It is a scalable form of Local Linear Attention (LLA), a mechanism with provable theoretical advantages over Softmax Attention.
mechanism_atoms: A drop-in upgrade to softmax attention: a scalable, solver-free form of Local Linear Attention that learns a query-like projector probing the KV covariance, with a hardware-aware decode kernel matching/outperforming FlashAttention 2/3; pretrained at 0.6B and 1.7B with consistent perplexity gains.

techniques.name: Reverso
techniques.capability_it_enables: A family of tiny (0.2M-2.6M param) zero-shot time-series foundation models that interleave long-convolution and linear-RNN (DeltaNet) layers, matching transformer-based forecasters over 100x larger; pushes the performance-efficiency Pareto frontier. Reverso-Small checkpoint released (others 'coming soon').
techniques.summary_verbatim: By combining long convolutions with linear RNN layers, Reverso matches the performance of transformer-based models that are over 100x larger.
mechanism_atoms: A family of tiny (0.2M-2.6M param) zero-shot time-series foundation models that interleave long-convolution and linear-RNN (DeltaNet) layers, matching transformer-based forecasters over 100x larger; pushes the performance-efficiency Pareto frontier. Reverso-Small checkpoint released (others 'coming soon').

techniques.name: Toto 2.0
techniques.capability_it_enables: An open-weights family of multivariate time-series forecasting foundation models (4M to 2.5B params) trained under one u-muP-scaled recipe, setting state of the art on the BOOM observability benchmark, GIFT-Eval, and the contamination-resistant TIME benchmark; captures multivariate interactions, long context, and cross-domain transfer.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Toto is a foundation model for multivariate time series forecasting with a focus on observability metrics.
mechanism_atoms: An open-weights family of multivariate time-series forecasting foundation models (4M to 2.5B params) trained under one u-muP-scaled recipe, setting state of the art on the BOOM observability benchmark, GIFT-Eval, and the contamination-resistant TIME benchmark; captures multivariate interactions, long context, and cross-domain transfer.

techniques.name: VETime (Vision Enhanced Zero-Shot Time Series Anomaly Detection)
techniques.subfield: Time-series foundation models / anomaly detection backbone
techniques.capability_it_enables: Zero-shot time-series anomaly-detection backbone that unifies temporal and visual modalities via reversible image conversion, patch-level temporal alignment, anomaly-window contrastive learning, and task-adaptive multi-modal fusion; superior zero-shot localization with lower compute than vision-based baselines. Pretrained checkpoints released.
techniques.summary_verbatim: VETime significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models in zero-shot scenarios, achieving superior localization precision with lower computational overhead
mechanism_atoms: Zero-shot time-series anomaly-detection backbone that unifies temporal and visual modalities via reversible image conversion, patch-level temporal alignment, anomaly-window contrastive learning, and task-adaptive multi-modal fusion; superior zero-shot localization with lower compute than vision-based baselines. Pretrained checkpoints released.

techniques.name: TimeRadar (Domain-Rotatable Foundation Model for TS Anomaly Detection)
techniques.subfield: Time-series foundation models / anomaly detection backbone
techniques.capability_it_enables: Generalist zero-shot time-series anomaly detection across unseen datasets via a fractional time-frequency domain: a Fractionally modulated Time-Frequency Reconstruction (FTFRecon) module rotates the series to a learnable fractional order, plus Contextual Deviation Learning for local abnormality; reports avg +10.5% AUC-R and +29.4% AUC-P.
techniques.summary_verbatim: TimeRadar is an innovative time series foundation model (TSFM) built in a fractional time-frequency domain to support generalist time series anomaly detection (TSAD) across diverse unseen datasets.
mechanism_atoms: Generalist zero-shot time-series anomaly detection across unseen datasets via a fractional time-frequency domain: a Fractionally modulated Time-Frequency Reconstruction (FTFRecon) module rotates the series to a learnable fractional order, plus Contextual Deviation Learning for local abnormality; reports avg +10.5% AUC-R and +29.4% AUC-P.

techniques.name: Flow2GAN (Hybrid Flow Matching + GAN, Multi-Resolution Network)
techniques.capability_it_enables: High-fidelity audio generation/vocoding from Mel-spectrograms or discrete audio tokens with few-step (even one-step) inference, combining flow matching and GAN training.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Flow2GAN enables high-fidelity audio generation from Mel-spectrograms or discrete audio tokens with efficient few-step (even one-step) inference.
mechanism_atoms: High-fidelity audio generation/vocoding from Mel-spectrograms or discrete audio tokens with few-step (even one-step) inference, combining flow matching and GAN training.

techniques.name: SGNO: Spectral Generator Neural Operator
techniques.capability_it_enables: Stable long-horizon autoregressive PDE rollouts via a residual time-stepper using exponential time differencing in Fourier space with a learned diagonal generator; lower long-horizon error than baselines on 1D/2D/3D PDE families.
techniques.summary_verbatim: SGNO maps the current state and coordinates to the next state through a residual neural operator.
mechanism_atoms: Stable long-horizon autoregressive PDE rollouts via a residual time-stepper using exponential time differencing in Fourier space with a learned diagonal generator; lower long-horizon error than baselines on 1D/2D/3D PDE families.

techniques.name: Lance (3B native unified multimodal model for image+video generation/editing)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Single 3B model that performs image and video understanding, generation, and editing including image-to-video (i2v) within one framework; weights released on HuggingFace.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Lance is a 3B native unified multimodal model that supports image and video understanding, generation, and editing within a single framework.
mechanism_atoms: Single 3B model that performs image and video understanding, generation, and editing including image-to-video (i2v) within one framework; weights released on HuggingFace.

techniques.name: Bernini (MLLM semantic planner + DiT renderer for video generation/editing)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Unified video generation and editing that combines an MLLM-based semantic planner with a DiT-based renderer; inference code and model weights (Bernini-R) released.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Bernini is a unified framework for video generation and editing that combines an MLLM-based semantic planner with a DiT-based renderer.
mechanism_atoms: Unified video generation and editing that combines an MLLM-based semantic planner with a DiT-based renderer; inference code and model weights (Bernini-R) released.

techniques.name: MeanVoiceFlow (One-step Nonparallel Voice Conversion with Mean Flows)
techniques.capability_it_enables: One-step nonparallel voice conversion trained from scratch (no distillation), using average-velocity mean flows to compute the time integral along the inference path in a single step.
techniques.summary_verbatim: mean flows employ average velocity to compute the time integral along the inference path in a single step
mechanism_atoms: One-step nonparallel voice conversion trained from scratch (no distillation), using average-velocity mean flows to compute the time integral along the inference path in a single step.

techniques.name: FLAC: Few-shot Acoustic Synthesis with Multimodal Flow Matching
techniques.subfield: Generative models beyond images (scientific/acoustic data - room impulse responses)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Few-shot generation of room impulse responses (RIRs) at arbitrary positions in novel scenes using a DiT trained with a flow-matching objective, conditioned on spatial/geometric/acoustic cues; one-shot beats SOTA eight-shot baselines.
techniques.summary_verbatim: FLAC leverages a diffusion transformer trained with a flow-matching objective to generate RIRs at arbitrary positions in novel scenes, conditioned on spatial, geometric, and acoustic cues.
mechanism_atoms: Few-shot generation of room impulse responses (RIRs) at arbitrary positions in novel scenes using a DiT trained with a flow-matching objective, conditioned on spatial/geometric/acoustic cues; one-shot beats SOTA eight-shot baselines.

techniques.name: UNISON: Unified Sound Generation and Editing via Deep LLM Fusion
techniques.capability_it_enables: Single latent-diffusion model with shared weights handling text-to-audio, text-to-speech, zero-shot speaker cloning, mixed speech-and-sound generation, and scene-level audio editing via layer-wise deep LLM fusion (~4x smaller than comparable unified systems).
techniques.summary_verbatim: A single model handles text-to-audio, text-to-speech, zero-shot speaker cloning, mixed speech-and-sound generation, scene-level audio editing, speech-in-scene editing, and timed temporal composition, all of which share a single set of weights.
mechanism_atoms: Single latent-diffusion model with shared weights handling text-to-audio, text-to-speech, zero-shot speaker cloning, mixed speech-and-sound generation, and scene-level audio editing via layer-wise deep LLM fusion (~4x smaller than comparable unified systems).

techniques.name: OGPP: Orbit-Space Particle Flow Matching (Orbit-Space Geometric Probability Paths)
techniques.subfield: Generative models beyond images (3D / scientific particle systems)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Particle-native flow-matching for generative modeling of particle/point systems using orbit-space canonicalization and geometric probability paths; reduces metric error by up to two orders of magnitude in a single inference step on minimal-surface benchmarks and matches SOTA with 5x fewer steps on ShapeNet.
techniques.summary_verbatim: particles live in physical space, so the flow terminal velocity has physical meaning and can encode geometric attributes, e.g., surface normals.
mechanism_atoms: Particle-native flow-matching for generative modeling of particle/point systems using orbit-space canonicalization and geometric probability paths; reduces metric error by up to two orders of magnitude in a single inference step on minimal-surface benchmarks and matches SOTA with 5x fewer steps on ShapeNet.

techniques.name: Cellular Sheaf Neural Operators for Structure-Preserving PDE Surrogates
techniques.subfield: Scientific ML / neural operators (constrained PDEs, MHD/fusion)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Discretization-aware, structure-preserving neural PDE surrogate that represents states on oriented cell complexes and uses incidence/Hodge-informed message passing; improves divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium regression on turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium tasks.
techniques.summary_verbatim: On turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium surrogate tasks, the method improves structure-sensitive diagnostics, including rollout behavior, divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium-regression accuracy.
mechanism_atoms: Discretization-aware, structure-preserving neural PDE surrogate that represents states on oriented cell complexes and uses incidence/Hodge-informed message passing; improves divergence control, spectral error, and equilibrium regression on turbulent MHD and fusion-equilibrium tasks.

techniques.name: Langevin Speculative Dynamics (LSD) - Speculative Sampling for Faster Molecular Dynamics
techniques.capability_it_enables: Distributed, model-agnostic speculative sampler that accelerates molecular dynamics without adding relative error by using a fast draft model proposing steps verified in parallel by a slower target model; error-free speedups of up to 9x.
techniques.summary_verbatim: LSD uses a draft model to propose fast simulation steps and verifies them in parallel with a slower target model, applying a transport map from the draft to the target distribution.
mechanism_atoms: Distributed, model-agnostic speculative sampler that accelerates molecular dynamics without adding relative error by using a fast draft model proposing steps verified in parallel by a slower target model; error-free speedups of up to 9x.

techniques.name: GIST: Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformers for Scalable Graph Neural Operators
techniques.subfield: Scientific ML / neural operators (graph/mesh PDE surrogates)
techniques.capability_it_enables: O(N)-complexity, gauge-invariant spectral positional encodings for graph/mesh neural operators that avoid cubic eigendecomposition while preserving gauge symmetry, improving inductive generalization on meshes.
techniques.summary_verbatim: GIST (Gauge-Invariant Spectral Transformer) is a graph transformer that resolves the tension between exact spectral methods and efficient approximations by restricting attention to pairwise inner products of efficient approximate spectral embeddings.
mechanism_atoms: O(N)-complexity, gauge-invariant spectral positional encodings for graph/mesh neural operators that avoid cubic eigendecomposition while preserving gauge symmetry, improving inductive generalization on meshes.

techniques.name: SCNO: Spiking Compositional Neural Operator (Neuromorphic Foundation Model for Nuclear PDEs)
techniques.subfield: Scientific ML / neural operators (compositional PDE solving)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Modular spiking neural operator that keeps a library of small blocks each trained on a single elementary differential operator (convection, diffusion, reaction) and composes them via an input-conditioned aggregator to solve coupled PDEs unseen during training, with ~95K parameters.
techniques.summary_verbatim: SCNO with correction achieves the lowest relative L2 error on four of five coupled PDEs, outperforming both a monolithic spiking DeepONet (by up to 62%) and a standard ANN DeepONet (by up to 65%), while requiring only 95K trainable parameters versus 462K for the monolithic baseline.
mechanism_atoms: Modular spiking neural operator that keeps a library of small blocks each trained on a single elementary differential operator (convection, diffusion, reaction) and composes them via an input-conditioned aggregator to solve coupled PDEs unseen during training, with ~95K parameters.

techniques.name: E3RelaxH2 (high-degree, high-order equivariant GNN for direct crystal structure optimization)
techniques.subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
techniques.capability_it_enables: Maps an unrelaxed crystal directly to its DFT-relaxed structure (atomic positions and lattice parameters) in a single equivariant forward pass, avoiding iterative DFT relaxation. Pretrained checkpoints (c2db, mp, xmno) and datasets are released on Zenodo.
techniques.summary_verbatim: E3RelaxH2 is an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network that predicts relaxed crystal structures (atomic positions and lattice parameters) from unrelaxed inputs in a single forward pass.
mechanism_atoms: Maps an unrelaxed crystal directly to its DFT-relaxed structure (atomic positions and lattice parameters) in a single equivariant forward pass, avoiding iterative DFT relaxation. Pretrained checkpoints (c2db, mp, xmno) and datasets are released on Zenodo.

techniques.name: GREPO (graph neural network benchmark + GNN retrievers/rerankers for repository-level bug localization)
techniques.subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
techniques.capability_it_enables: Provides the first GNN benchmark for repository-scale bug localization (86 Python repos, 47,294 bug-fixing tasks) together with official GNN retriever/reranker training and evaluation code and a dataset on ModelScope, enabling graph-structured code reasoning for software engineering.
techniques.summary_verbatim: This repository is the official code implementation for the paper 'GREPO: A Benchmark for Graph Neural Networks on Repository-Level Bug Localization'.
mechanism_atoms: Provides the first GNN benchmark for repository-scale bug localization (86 Python repos, 47,294 bug-fixing tasks) together with official GNN retriever/reranker training and evaluation code and a dataset on ModelScope, enabling graph-structured code reasoning for software engineering.

techniques.name: Tensor Channel Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (molecular polarizability prediction)
techniques.subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
techniques.capability_it_enables: Directly predicts full molecular polarizability tensors by augmenting a PaiNN-style equivariant message-passing network with explicit symmetric rank-2 tensor channels aligned with the isotropic/anisotropic decomposition of polarizability.
techniques.summary_verbatim: a tensor-channel equivariant graph neural network for direct prediction of molecular polarizability tensors, building on the efficient PaiNN architecture and augmenting the hidden representation with explicit symmetric rank-2 tensor channels aligned with the decomposition of polarizability into isotropic and anisotropic components
mechanism_atoms: Directly predicts full molecular polarizability tensors by augmenting a PaiNN-style equivariant message-passing network with explicit symmetric rank-2 tensor channels aligned with the isotropic/anisotropic decomposition of polarizability.

techniques.name: GraphBFF (Billion-Scale Graph Foundation Models)
techniques.subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
techniques.capability_it_enables: An end-to-end recipe (GraphBFF Transformer) for training billion-parameter graph foundation models on arbitrary heterogeneous billion-scale graphs, establishing neural scaling laws for general graphs and achieving strong zero-shot/probing transfer to unseen node- and link-level tasks (up to +31 PRAUC points).
techniques.summary_verbatim: GraphBFF (Graph Billion-Foundation-Fusion), the first end-to-end recipe for building billion-parameter Graph Foundation Models for arbitrary heterogeneous, billion-scale graphs
mechanism_atoms: An end-to-end recipe (GraphBFF Transformer) for training billion-parameter graph foundation models on arbitrary heterogeneous billion-scale graphs, establishing neural scaling laws for general graphs and achieving strong zero-shot/probing transfer to unseen node- and link-level tasks (up to +31 PRAUC points).

techniques.name: Molmo2 (open-weight vision-language model with video understanding and pointing/grounding)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Open-weight VLM family (Molmo2-4B, Molmo2-8B, Molmo2-O-7B) with state-of-the-art point-driven visual grounding across single-image, multi-image, and video tasks; full code, pretrain/SFT checkpoints, and 9 new datasets are released.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Molmo2 is state-of-the-art among open-source models and demonstrates exceptional new capabilities in point-driven grounding in single image, multi-image, and video tasks
mechanism_atoms: Open-weight VLM family (Molmo2-4B, Molmo2-8B, Molmo2-O-7B) with state-of-the-art point-driven visual grounding across single-image, multi-image, and video tasks; full code, pretrain/SFT checkpoints, and 9 new datasets are released.

techniques.name: InternVL-U (unified multimodal model for understanding, reasoning, generation, and editing)
techniques.capability_it_enables: A single lightweight 4B-parameter unified multimodal model that performs multimodal understanding, reasoning, image generation, and image editing in one framework, outperforming prior open-source unified baselines on generation/editing while retaining strong understanding. Inference code and a HuggingFace checkpoint are released.
techniques.summary_verbatim: InternVL-U is a 4B-parameter unified multimodal model (UMM) that brings multimodal understanding, reasoning, image generation, image editing into a single framework
mechanism_atoms: A single lightweight 4B-parameter unified multimodal model that performs multimodal understanding, reasoning, image generation, and image editing in one framework, outperforming prior open-source unified baselines on generation/editing while retaining strong understanding. Inference code and a HuggingFace checkpoint are released.

techniques.name: VLA Foundry (unified single-codebase framework for training LLM -> VLM -> VLA models)
techniques.capability_it_enables: An open-source framework unifying LLM, VLM, and VLA training in one shared stack (language pretraining through action-expert fine-tuning), supporting both from-scratch training and HuggingFace pretrained backbones; trained LLM/VLM/VLA model weights (e.g. Foundry-VLA-1.7B-sim) are released on HuggingFace.
techniques.summary_verbatim: VLA Foundry is an open-source framework that unifies LLM, VLM, and VLA training in a single codebase.
mechanism_atoms: An open-source framework unifying LLM, VLM, and VLA training in one shared stack (language pretraining through action-expert fine-tuning), supporting both from-scratch training and HuggingFace pretrained backbones; trained LLM/VLM/VLA model weights (e.g. Foundry-VLA-1.7B-sim) are released on HuggingFace.

techniques.name: Health-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Models (malfunction-aware robot control)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Adds a Health Projector module to a VLA so the policy takes a health vector (per-joint operating angle and torque capability) as input and adapts its action predictions to complete tasks even with degraded/failing robot joints. Note: repo states code and dataset will be released later, so no usable code yet.
techniques.summary_verbatim: malfunction-aware (health-conditioned) VLA that takes a health vector as an input that gives information about robots' joints' operation angle and torque capability, and adapts its predictions to complete the tasks with the degraded joints
mechanism_atoms: Adds a Health Projector module to a VLA so the policy takes a health vector (per-joint operating angle and torque capability) as input and adapts its action predictions to complete tasks even with degraded/failing robot joints. Note: repo states code and dataset will be released later, so no usable code yet.

techniques.name: SIGMA-PPG
techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (PPG bio-signals)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Self-supervised PPG foundation model using a Prior-Guided Adversarial Masking mechanism; pretrained on 120,000+ hours of photoplethysmography, it produces general representations that beat five SOTA baselines across 12 downstream health tasks. Pretrained checkpoints released on HuggingFace.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Pre-trained on over 120,000 hours of data, SIGMA-PPG achieves superior average performance compared to five state-of-the-art baselines across 12 diverse downstream tasks.
mechanism_atoms: Self-supervised PPG foundation model using a Prior-Guided Adversarial Masking mechanism; pretrained on 120,000+ hours of photoplethysmography, it produces general representations that beat five SOTA baselines across 12 downstream health tasks. Pretrained checkpoints released on HuggingFace.

techniques.name: PulseLM
techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (PPG bio-signals + language)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Multimodal framework pairing PPG signal encoders with LLMs for physiological-signal reasoning; ships a large PPG-text QA dataset (1.31M 10s segments, 3.15M QA pairs across 12 clinical tasks), training/eval code, and model checkpoints + dataset on HuggingFace.
techniques.summary_verbatim: PulseLM is a multimodal framework that integrates PPG (Photoplethysmography) signal encoders with large language models for physiological signal understanding research.
mechanism_atoms: Multimodal framework pairing PPG signal encoders with LLMs for physiological-signal reasoning; ships a large PPG-text QA dataset (1.31M 10s segments, 3.15M QA pairs across 12 clinical tasks), training/eval code, and model checkpoints + dataset on HuggingFace.

techniques.name: SAM-Audio (Segment Anything in Audio)
techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Diffusion-transformer foundation model (Meta) for general audio source separation that unifies text, visual, and temporal-span prompting in one framework; isolates any sound in a mixture. Code installable via pip and checkpoints (sam-audio-large) released on HuggingFace.
techniques.summary_verbatim: SAM-Audio is a foundation model for isolating any sound in audio using text, visual, or temporal prompts.
mechanism_atoms: Diffusion-transformer foundation model (Meta) for general audio source separation that unifies text, visual, and temporal-span prompting in one framework; isolates any sound in a mixture. Code installable via pip and checkpoints (sam-audio-large) released on HuggingFace.

techniques.name: Woosh (Sound Effects Foundation Model)
techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Sony AI sound-effects foundation model bundling a high-quality audio encoder/decoder (Woosh-AE), a text-audio alignment model (Woosh-CLAP), and text-to-audio + video-to-audio generative models, including distilled fast-inference variants. Inference code and open weights released.
techniques.summary_verbatim: This repository provides inference code and open weights for the sound effect generative models developed at Sony AI.
mechanism_atoms: Sony AI sound-effects foundation model bundling a high-quality audio encoder/decoder (Woosh-AE), a text-audio alignment model (Woosh-CLAP), and text-to-audio + video-to-audio generative models, including distilled fast-inference variants. Inference code and open weights released.

techniques.name: Audio-Omni
techniques.subfield: Self-supervised / representation learning for sensing signals (audio)
techniques.capability_it_enables: End-to-end framework unifying understanding, generation, and editing across general sound, music, and speech; couples a frozen Qwen2.5-Omni MLLM with a trainable Diffusion Transformer, plus a new 1M-pair AudioEdit dataset. Code on GitHub and model checkpoint on HuggingFace.
techniques.summary_verbatim: the first end-to-end framework to unify understanding, generation, and editing across general sound, music, and speech domains.
mechanism_atoms: End-to-end framework unifying understanding, generation, and editing across general sound, music, and speech; couples a frozen Qwen2.5-Omni MLLM with a trainable Diffusion Transformer, plus a new 1M-pair AudioEdit dataset. Code on GitHub and model checkpoint on HuggingFace.

techniques.name: Sparse-BitNet
techniques.subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (extreme quantization + sparsity)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Training/inference framework that combines 1.58-bit (ternary) BitLinear quantization with N:M structured sparsity, showing 1.58-bit LLMs are naturally friendly to semi-structured sparsity for efficient on-device LLMs. Runnable train.py / eval.py / generate.py provided.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Training framework for Sparse-BitNet models -- combining 1.58-bit quantization (BitLinear) with N:M structured sparsity for efficient LLM training and inference.
mechanism_atoms: Training/inference framework that combines 1.58-bit (ternary) BitLinear quantization with N:M structured sparsity, showing 1.58-bit LLMs are naturally friendly to semi-structured sparsity for efficient on-device LLMs. Runnable train.py / eval.py / generate.py provided.

techniques.name: Agent Memory Below the Prompt (Persistent Q4 KV Cache)
techniques.subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (edge KV-cache quantization)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Persists each agent's KV cache to disk as 4-bit quantized safetensors and reloads it directly into attention, eliminating redundant prefill for multi-agent LLM inference on edge devices; cuts time-to-first-token by up to 136x and fits 4x more agent contexts in fixed memory vs FP16. Open-source code for Apple Silicon.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Persistent KV cache for multi-agent LLM systems on Apple Silicon.
mechanism_atoms: Persists each agent's KV cache to disk as 4-bit quantized safetensors and reloads it directly into attention, eliminating redundant prefill for multi-agent LLM inference on edge devices; cuts time-to-first-token by up to 136x and fits 4x more agent contexts in fixed memory vs FP16. Open-source code for Apple Silicon.

techniques.name: EEG-DLite
techniques.subfield: Efficient / on-device / small models (data distillation for efficient sensing-model training)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Dataset-distillation framework that encodes EEG segments into compact latent representations and filters out noisy/redundant samples, enabling more efficient pre-training of large EEG foundation models on a smaller curated subset (AAAI 2026). Runnable distillation + LaBraM pretraining scripts.
techniques.summary_verbatim: EEG-DLite is the first systematic framework for pre-training data distillation in EEG foundation models.
mechanism_atoms: Dataset-distillation framework that encodes EEG segments into compact latent representations and filters out noisy/redundant samples, enabling more efficient pre-training of large EEG foundation models on a smaller curated subset (AAAI 2026). Runnable distillation + LaBraM pretraining scripts.

techniques.name: Dreamer-CDP
techniques.capability_it_enables: Reconstruction-free model-based RL: a JEPA-style predictor over continuous, deterministic latent representations predicts the next abstract state instead of reconstructing pixels, matching Dreamer's performance on Crafter without any reconstruction objective.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Dreamer-CDP: Improving Reconstruction-free World Models Via Continuous Deterministic Representation Prediction
mechanism_atoms: Reconstruction-free model-based RL: a JEPA-style predictor over continuous, deterministic latent representations predicts the next abstract state instead of reconstructing pixels, matching Dreamer's performance on Crafter without any reconstruction objective.

techniques.name: ProRL Agent (Rollout-as-a-Service)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Scalable multi-turn agentic RL training infrastructure that decouples the full rollout lifecycle (init/run/evaluate) from the GPU trainer via an HTTP rollout-as-a-service API, enabling rollout and training to run on separate machines with standardized sandbox environments.
techniques.summary_verbatim: ProRL Agent: Rollout-as-a-Service for RL Training of Multi-Turn LLM Agents
mechanism_atoms: Scalable multi-turn agentic RL training infrastructure that decouples the full rollout lifecycle (init/run/evaluate) from the GPU trainer via an HTTP rollout-as-a-service API, enabling rollout and training to run on separate machines with standardized sandbox environments.

techniques.name: DART (Disentangled Action Reasoning Tuning)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Resolves gradient interference between reasoning and tool-use in agentic RL by routing reasoning vs. tool-use tokens to disjoint LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone, so updates for the two capabilities never collide.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Reasoning and Tool-use Compete in Agentic RL: From Quantifying Interference to Disentangled Tuning
mechanism_atoms: Resolves gradient interference between reasoning and tool-use in agentic RL by routing reasoning vs. tool-use tokens to disjoint LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone, so updates for the two capabilities never collide.

techniques.name: WorldCompass
techniques.capability_it_enables: RL post-training framework for long-horizon interactive video world models, using a clip-level rollout strategy, complementary interaction-accuracy + visual-quality rewards, and negative-aware fine-tuning to improve interaction accuracy and visual fidelity over the open WorldPlay model.
techniques.summary_verbatim: WorldCompass: Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon World Models
mechanism_atoms: RL post-training framework for long-horizon interactive video world models, using a clip-level rollout strategy, complementary interaction-accuracy + visual-quality rewards, and negative-aware fine-tuning to improve interaction accuracy and visual fidelity over the open WorldPlay model.

techniques.name: World-Gymnast
techniques.capability_it_enables: RL finetuning of a vision-language-action (VLA) policy by rolling out the policy inside an action-conditioned video world model and scoring rollouts with a VLM-based reward, outperforming SFT by up to 18x and a software simulator by up to 2x on the Bridge robot setup.
techniques.summary_verbatim: World-Gymnast: Training Robots with Reinforcement Learning in a World Model
mechanism_atoms: RL finetuning of a vision-language-action (VLA) policy by rolling out the policy inside an action-conditioned video world model and scoring rollouts with a VLM-based reward, outperforming SFT by up to 18x and a software simulator by up to 2x on the Bridge robot setup.

techniques.name: AWPO (Advantage-Weighted Policy Optimization)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Integrates chain-of-thought reasoning-quality rewards into RLVR advantage estimation for tool-use via variance-aware gating and difficulty-aware weighting, with a 4B model reportedly surpassing Grok-4 by 16.0% in multi-turn tool-use accuracy.
techniques.summary_verbatim: AWPO: Enhancing Tool-Use of Large Language Models through Adaptive Integration of Reasoning Rewards
mechanism_atoms: Integrates chain-of-thought reasoning-quality rewards into RLVR advantage estimation for tool-use via variance-aware gating and difficulty-aware weighting, with a 4B model reportedly surpassing Grok-4 by 16.0% in multi-turn tool-use accuracy.

techniques.name: MolCrystalFlow
techniques.subfield: A: flow matching for molecular crystal structure prediction
techniques.capability_it_enables: Predicts molecular crystal structures by embedding molecules as rigid bodies and jointly learning the lattice matrix, molecular orientations and centroid positions on their native Riemannian manifolds via geodesic flow matching.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The framework disentangles intramolecular complexity from intermolecular packing by embedding molecules as rigid bodies and jointly learning the lattice matrix, molecular orientations, and centroid positions.
mechanism_atoms: Predicts molecular crystal structures by embedding molecules as rigid bodies and jointly learning the lattice matrix, molecular orientations and centroid positions on their native Riemannian manifolds via geodesic flow matching.

techniques.name: EnFlow (Energy-Guided Flow Matching)
techniques.subfield: A: flow matching for molecular conformer generation / ground-state identification
techniques.capability_it_enables: Couples flow matching with an explicitly learned energy model via energy-guided sampling to produce high-fidelity molecular conformers and identify ground states in just 1-2 ODE steps.
techniques.summary_verbatim: By incorporating energy-gradient guidance during sampling, this method steers trajectories toward lower-energy regions, substantially improving conformational fidelity, particularly in the few-step regime.
mechanism_atoms: Couples flow matching with an explicitly learned energy model via energy-guided sampling to produce high-fidelity molecular conformers and identify ground states in just 1-2 ODE steps.

techniques.name: SymTorch
techniques.subfield: B: symbolic regression / symbolic distillation of neural networks
techniques.capability_it_enables: Wraps neural-network components (GNNs, PINNs, transformers), collects their input-output behavior, and replaces them with human-readable closed-form equations via PySR, enabling interpretability of trained models.
techniques.summary_verbatim: SymTorch automates distillation by wrapping neural network components, collecting their input-output behavior, and approximating them with human-readable equations via PySR, while handling engineering challenges including GPU-CPU data transfer, input-output caching, model serialization, and seamless switching between neural and symbolic forward passes.
mechanism_atoms: Wraps neural-network components (GNNs, PINNs, transformers), collects their input-output behavior, and replaces them with human-readable closed-form equations via PySR, enabling interpretability of trained models.

techniques.name: OrgFlow
techniques.subfield: A: flow matching for organic crystal structure generation from molecular graphs
techniques.capability_it_enables: Generates organic crystal structures directly from the asymmetric-unit molecular graph, integrating molecular connectivity with periodic boundary conditions and using a bond-aware Student-t regularizer for realistic covalent geometry.
techniques.summary_verbatim: OrgFlow is the first flow-matching framework that (i) conditions explicitly on the asymmetric-unit molecular graph, (ii) trains on a large organic-only corpus with molecule-disjoint splits, and (iii) introduces a bond-aware Student-t regularizer tailored to organic covalent geometry.
mechanism_atoms: Generates organic crystal structures directly from the asymmetric-unit molecular graph, integrating molecular connectivity with periodic boundary conditions and using a bond-aware Student-t regularizer for realistic covalent geometry.

techniques.name: SGN (Symbolic Graph Networks for PDE Discovery)
techniques.subfield: B: equation discovery / symbolic regression for PDEs from noisy sparse data
techniques.capability_it_enables: Discovers governing PDEs from noisy, sparse data by using graph message passing for a non-local representation (robust to high-frequency noise) and a symbolic regression module to extract interpretable equations.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Instead of relying on local differential approximations, SGN leverages graph message passing to model spatial interactions, providing a non-local representation that is less sensitive to high-frequency noise.
mechanism_atoms: Discovers governing PDEs from noisy, sparse data by using graph message passing for a non-local representation (robust to high-frequency noise) and a symbolic regression module to extract interpretable equations.

techniques.name: PuckerFlow
techniques.subfield: A: flow matching for cyclic/ring conformer generation
techniques.capability_it_enables: Generates conformers of cyclic (ring) structures by performing flow matching in low-dimensional Cremer-Pople ring-puckering coordinates, outperforming prior conformer generators on most metrics for drug-discovery and catalysis ring systems.
techniques.summary_verbatim: PuckerFlow is a generative machine learning model that performs flow matching on the Cremer-Pople space, a low-dimensional internal coordinate system capturing the relevant degrees of freedom of rings.
mechanism_atoms: Generates conformers of cyclic (ring) structures by performing flow matching in low-dimensional Cremer-Pople ring-puckering coordinates, outperforming prior conformer generators on most metrics for drug-discovery and catalysis ring systems.

techniques.name: ShapPFN
techniques.capability_it_enables: Tabular foundation model that integrates Shapley value regression into its architecture, producing predictions and feature-importance explanations in a single forward pass, ~1000x faster than KernelSHAP (0.06s vs 610s).
techniques.summary_verbatim: ShapPFN is a foundation model that integrates Shapley value regression directly into its architecture, producing both predictions and explanations in a single forward pass.
mechanism_atoms: Tabular foundation model that integrates Shapley value regression into its architecture, producing predictions and feature-importance explanations in a single forward pass, ~1000x faster than KernelSHAP (0.06s vs 610s).

techniques.name: CANDI (Curated Test-Time Adaptation)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Test-time adaptation framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection under distribution shift; uses False Positive Mining and a plug-and-play Spatiotemporally-Aware Normality Adaptation module, improving AUROC up to 14% with fewer adaptation samples.
techniques.summary_verbatim: CANDI introduces a False Positive Mining (FPM) strategy to curate adaptation samples based on anomaly scores and latent similarity, and incorporates a plug-and-play Spatiotemporally-Aware Normality Adaptation (SANA) module for structurally informed model updates.
mechanism_atoms: Test-time adaptation framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection under distribution shift; uses False Positive Mining and a plug-and-play Spatiotemporally-Aware Normality Adaptation module, improving AUROC up to 14% with fewer adaptation samples.

techniques.name: ViT3 / ViTTT (Vision Test-Time Training)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Pure test-time-training architecture for vision achieving linear complexity and parallelizable computation; matches/outperforms Mamba and linear-attention variants across image classification, generation, object detection, and semantic segmentation. CVPR 2026 Oral.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The Vision Test-Time Training (ViT3) model is a pure TTT architecture that achieves linear complexity and parallelizable computation.
mechanism_atoms: Pure test-time-training architecture for vision achieving linear complexity and parallelizable computation; matches/outperforms Mamba and linear-attention variants across image classification, generation, object detection, and semantic segmentation. CVPR 2026 Oral.

techniques.name: VISION (Graph Few-Shot Learning via In-Context Learning)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Reframes graph few-shot node classification as a fine-tuning-free sequence reasoning (in-context learning) problem; conditions on the support set and generates class-aware query representations in a single forward pass, unifying unsupervised meta-learning with graph in-context learning.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The method unifies unsupervised meta-learning with graph in-context learning, achieving efficient inference.
mechanism_atoms: Reframes graph few-shot node classification as a fine-tuning-free sequence reasoning (in-context learning) problem; conditions on the support set and generates class-aware query representations in a single forward pass, unifying unsupervised meta-learning with graph in-context learning.

techniques.name: KernelICL
techniques.capability_it_enables: Makes tabular-foundation-model in-context learning interpretable by replacing the final prediction layer with explicit kernel functions (Gaussian, dot-product, kNN), so each prediction is a transparent weighted average of training labels; matches existing TFMs on 55 TALENT datasets.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The key innovation is building on the insight that in-context learning is akin to kernel regression, making this mechanism explicit by replacing the final prediction layer with kernel functions (Gaussian, dot-product, kNN) so that every prediction is a transparent weighted average of training labels.
mechanism_atoms: Makes tabular-foundation-model in-context learning interpretable by replacing the final prediction layer with explicit kernel functions (Gaussian, dot-product, kNN), so each prediction is a transparent weighted average of training labels; matches existing TFMs on 55 TALENT datasets.

techniques.name: TabFORGE (Tabular Foundation Model for Generative Modelling)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Tabular foundation model for synthetic-data generation built on pretrained causality-aware latent representations; two-stage design (score-based diffusion transformer + denoising-aligned decoder) to mitigate train/inference latent distribution shift; evaluated vs 22 baselines on 45 datasets.
techniques.summary_verbatim: TabFORGE is designed to utilise the implicitly learned causal information underlying diverse tabular datasets in a unified latent space induced by a pretrained causality-aware feature encoder.
mechanism_atoms: Tabular foundation model for synthetic-data generation built on pretrained causality-aware latent representations; two-stage design (score-based diffusion transformer + denoising-aligned decoder) to mitigate train/inference latent distribution shift; evaluated vs 22 baselines on 45 datasets.

techniques.name: HOLOGRAPH: Active Causal Discovery via Sheaf-Theoretic Alignment of LLM Priors
techniques.capability_it_enables: LLM-guided active causal discovery that represents local causal beliefs as sheaf sections, handles hidden confounders via Algebraic Latent Projection, and uses Expected Free Energy to select maximally informative LLM queries (synthetic ER/SF and real Sachs benchmarks, 20-100 variables).
techniques.summary_verbatim: HOLOGRAPH is a framework that formalizes LLM-guided causal discovery through sheaf theory--representing local causal beliefs as sections of a presheaf over variable subsets.
mechanism_atoms: LLM-guided active causal discovery that represents local causal beliefs as sheaf sections, handles hidden confounders via Algebraic Latent Projection, and uses Expected Free Energy to select maximally informative LLM queries (synthetic ER/SF and real Sachs benchmarks, 20-100 variables).

techniques.name: Large Causal Models (LCMs) for Temporal Causal Discovery
techniques.subfield: A: temporal causal discovery (pre-trained foundation model)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Pre-trained neural architectures (foundation-model style) for temporal causal discovery, trained at scale by combining diverse synthetic generators with realistic time-series datasets; released model weights enable amortized inference of temporal causal structure.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The paper proposes Large Causal Models (LCMs), a class of pre-trained neural architectures specifically designed for temporal causal discovery, combining diverse synthetic generators with realistic time-series datasets.
mechanism_atoms: Pre-trained neural architectures (foundation-model style) for temporal causal discovery, trained at scale by combining diverse synthetic generators with realistic time-series datasets; released model weights enable amortized inference of temporal causal structure.

techniques.name: CausalCompass: Robustness Benchmark for Time-Series Causal Discovery in Misspecified Scenarios
techniques.capability_it_enables: Extensible benchmark suite to assess robustness of time-series causal discovery (TSCD) methods across eight assumption-violation scenarios; finds deep-learning approaches strongest overall and exposes preprocessing dependence (e.g., NTS-NOTEARS needs standardization).
techniques.summary_verbatim: CausalCompass is a flexible and extensible benchmark suite designed to assess the robustness of time-series causal discovery (TSCD) methods under violations of modeling assumptions.
mechanism_atoms: Extensible benchmark suite to assess robustness of time-series causal discovery (TSCD) methods across eight assumption-violation scenarios; finds deep-learning approaches strongest overall and exposes preprocessing dependence (e.g., NTS-NOTEARS needs standardization).

techniques.name: Beyond identifiability: Learning causal representations with few environments and finite samples
techniques.capability_it_enables: Explicit finite-sample guarantees for causal representation learning from a sublinear (logarithmic) number of unknown multi-node interventions, with consistent recovery of the latent causal graph, mixing matrix/representations, and unknown intervention targets without pre-designed targets.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The paper shows that causal representations can be learned with only a logarithmic number of unknown, multi-node interventions, and that intervention targets need not be carefully designed in advance.
mechanism_atoms: Explicit finite-sample guarantees for causal representation learning from a sublinear (logarithmic) number of unknown multi-node interventions, with consistent recovery of the latent causal graph, mixing matrix/representations, and unknown intervention targets without pre-designed targets.

techniques.name: Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs) for Posterior Inference
techniques.capability_it_enables: Encode-merge-decode inference networks built on dimension-independent modules that map a model specification plus observations to variational posterior parameters; a single trained AFIN matches NUTS-level posterior accuracy while needing 2-4 orders of magnitude less test-time compute.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs) are a family of encode-merge-decode inference networks built on dimension-independent modules that map a model specification and its observations to the parameters of a variational posterior.
mechanism_atoms: Encode-merge-decode inference networks built on dimension-independent modules that map a model specification plus observations to variational posterior parameters; a single trained AFIN matches NUTS-level posterior accuracy while needing 2-4 orders of magnitude less test-time compute.

techniques.name: Robust Simulation Based Inference Through Robust Optimal Transport
techniques.capability_it_enables: Robust SBI under model misspecification using a Kullback-Leibler-informed robust Optimal Transport divergence; provides a stochastic sub-gradient ascent algorithm with convergence guarantees and a parallelized bootstrap-based SBI algorithm for parameter uncertainty quantification.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The authors introduce a stochastic sub-gradient ascent algorithm with a convergence guarantee for estimating the semi-discrete version of this robust Optimal Transport divergence, and design a parallelized SBI algorithm which employs the regular bootstrap on top of minimum semi-discrete robust Optimal Transport for parameter uncertainty quantification.
mechanism_atoms: Robust SBI under model misspecification using a Kullback-Leibler-informed robust Optimal Transport divergence; provides a stochastic sub-gradient ascent algorithm with convergence guarantees and a parallelized bootstrap-based SBI algorithm for parameter uncertainty quantification.

techniques.name: Bayesian Scattering: A Principled Baseline for Uncertainty on Image Data
techniques.subfield: B: Bayesian deep learning / uncertainty quantification
techniques.capability_it_enables: A non-learned deep feature extractor (wavelet scattering transform) coupled with a simple probabilistic head, serving as a principled UQ baseline for images; validated under distribution shift (medical imaging institution shift, country-to-country wealth mapping) and for Bayesian optimization of molecular properties.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The paper 'Bayesian Scattering: A Principled Baseline for Uncertainty on Image Data' (arXiv:2603.20908) proposes a method that couples the wavelet scattering transform—a deep, non-learned feature extractor—with a simple probabilistic head.
mechanism_atoms: A non-learned deep feature extractor (wavelet scattering transform) coupled with a simple probabilistic head, serving as a principled UQ baseline for images; validated under distribution shift (medical imaging institution shift, country-to-country wealth mapping) and for Bayesian optimization of molecular properties.

techniques.name: Amortized Simulation-Based Inference in Generalized Bayes via Neural Posterior Estimation
techniques.capability_it_enables: First fully amortized variational approximation to the tempered (generalized-Bayes) posterior family by training a neural posterior estimator, enabling sampling in a single forward pass without simulator calls or inference-time MCMC.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The paper 'Amortized Simulation-Based Inference in Generalized Bayes via Neural Posterior Estimation' (2601.22367) introduces the first fully amortized variational approximation to the tempered posterior family by training a neural posterior estimator that enables sampling in a single forward pass, without simulator calls or inference-time MCMC.
mechanism_atoms: First fully amortized variational approximation to the tempered (generalized-Bayes) posterior family by training a neural posterior estimator, enabling sampling in a single forward pass without simulator calls or inference-time MCMC.

techniques.name: Few-Shot Neural Differentiable Simulator (real-to-sim rigid-contact)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Calibrates analytical rigid-body simulators from a small amount of real-world data, then trains a mesh-based GNN that models rigid-body forward dynamics with surrogate collision gradients and full differentiability for real-to-sim contact modeling.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The method introduces a mesh-based GNN that implicitly models rigid-body forward dynamics and derives surrogate gradients for collision detection, achieving full differentiability.
mechanism_atoms: Calibrates analytical rigid-body simulators from a small amount of real-world data, then trains a mesh-based GNN that models rigid-body forward dynamics with surrogate collision gradients and full differentiability for real-to-sim contact modeling.

techniques.name: Frequency-Separable Hamiltonian Neural Network (FS-HNN)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Overcomes spectral bias in Hamiltonian NNs for multi-timescale dynamics by decomposing the Hamiltonian into fast/slow modes via multiple networks trained at distinct timescales; extends to PDEs via state- and boundary-conditioned symplectic operators, improving long-horizon extrapolation.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The paper introduces the Frequency-Separable Hamiltonian Neural Network (FS-HNN), which parameterizes the system Hamiltonian using multiple networks, each governed by Hamiltonian dynamics and trained on data sampled at distinct timescales.
mechanism_atoms: Overcomes spectral bias in Hamiltonian NNs for multi-timescale dynamics by decomposing the Hamiltonian into fast/slow modes via multiple networks trained at distinct timescales; extends to PDEs via state- and boundary-conditioned symplectic operators, improving long-horizon extrapolation.

techniques.name: ATLAS-NN (Adaptive Transfer Learnable Symplectic-aware Neural Network)
