techniques.capability_it_enables: Augments the HNN architecture with a learnable temporal-scaling (nonlinear time-reparameterization) mechanism plus a two-stage transfer-learning strategy to model long-time Hamiltonian dynamics with multiscale structure and rapid nonlinear transitions.
techniques.summary_verbatim: ATLAS-NN is a framework that augments the HNN architecture with a learnable temporal scaling mechanism that parametrize a nonlinear mapping of time, automatically adapting to the system's intrinsic complexity.
mechanism_atoms: Augments the HNN architecture with a learnable temporal-scaling (nonlinear time-reparameterization) mechanism plus a two-stage transfer-learning strategy to model long-time Hamiltonian dynamics with multiscale structure and rapid nonlinear transitions.

techniques.name: Symplectic Neural Operator (SNO)
techniques.capability_it_enables: A neural operator architecture that preserves the symplectic structure intrinsic to Hamiltonian PDEs, with theoretical symplecticity characterization and a long-term stability result; gives improved energy behavior over non-structure-preserving neural operators for infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian systems.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Numerical experiments on canonical Hamiltonian PDEs show that SNOs exhibit improved energy behavior compared with non-structure-preserving neural operators.
mechanism_atoms: A neural operator architecture that preserves the symplectic structure intrinsic to Hamiltonian PDEs, with theoretical symplecticity characterization and a long-term stability result; gives improved energy behavior over non-structure-preserving neural operators for infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian systems.

techniques.name: NEMF (Neural Electromagnetic Fields for material parameter reconstruction)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Neural-field framework for dense, non-invasive physical inversion: uses image-derived geometry as an anchor and a differentiable layer with physical reflection models to learn a continuous, spatially-varying field of material parameters (permittivity, conductivity) for functional digital twins.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Guided by ambient RF signals and a differentiable layer incorporating physical reflection models, it learns to explicitly output a continuous, spatially-varying field of the scene's underlying material parameters.
mechanism_atoms: Neural-field framework for dense, non-invasive physical inversion: uses image-derived geometry as an anchor and a differentiable layer with physical reflection models to learn a continuous, spatially-varying field of material parameters (permittivity, conductivity) for functional digital twins.

techniques.name: OmniVTA: Visuo-Tactile World Modeling for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
techniques.capability_it_enables: World-model-based visuo-tactile manipulation framework with a self-supervised tactile encoder, two-stream visuo-tactile world model predicting short-horizon contact evolution, contact-aware fusion policy, and 60Hz reflexive controller; built on OmniViTac dataset (21,000+ trajectories, 86 tasks).
techniques.summary_verbatim: OmniVTA is a world-model-based visuo-tactile manipulation framework that integrates four tightly coupled modules: a self-supervised tactile encoder, a two-stream visuo-tactile world model for predicting short-horizon contact evolution, a contact-aware fusion policy for action generation, and a 60Hz reflexive controller that corrects deviations between predicted and observed tactile signals in a closed loop.
mechanism_atoms: World-model-based visuo-tactile manipulation framework with a self-supervised tactile encoder, two-stream visuo-tactile world model predicting short-horizon contact evolution, contact-aware fusion policy, and 60Hz reflexive controller; built on OmniViTac dataset (21,000+ trajectories, 86 tasks).

techniques.name: Sound2Hap: Learning Audio-to-Vibrotactile Haptic Generation from Human Ratings
techniques.capability_it_enables: CNN-based autoencoder (CNN encoder + LSTM + residual vector quantization + SEANet decoder) that generates perceptually meaningful vibrotactile signals from diverse environmental sounds with low latency, trained on human ratings of 1,000 sounds.
techniques.summary_verbatim: Using this dataset, they trained Sound2Hap, a CNN-based autoencoder, to generate perceptually meaningful vibrations from diverse sounds with low latency.
mechanism_atoms: CNN-based autoencoder (CNN encoder + LSTM + residual vector quantization + SEANet decoder) that generates perceptually meaningful vibrotactile signals from diverse environmental sounds with low latency, trained on human ratings of 1,000 sounds.

techniques.name: Machine learning for smell: Ordinal odor strength prediction of molecular perfumery components
techniques.capability_it_enables: Curated ordinal odor-strength dataset of 2000+ molecules (odorless/low/medium/high) plus pipeline comparing multiple molecular encodings and supervised learners to predict odor strength directly from molecular structure for fragrance design.
techniques.summary_verbatim: The code is available on GitHub at `peter-fichtelmann/odor-strength`.
mechanism_atoms: Curated ordinal odor-strength dataset of 2000+ molecules (odorless/low/medium/high) plus pipeline comparing multiple molecular encodings and supervised learners to predict odor strength directly from molecular structure for fragrance design.

techniques.name: TouchAnything: Diffusion-Guided 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Robot Touches
techniques.capability_it_enables: Leverages a pretrained large-scale 2D vision diffusion model as a semantic and geometric prior to reconstruct accurate 3D geometry from only a few sparse tactile measurements, enabling open-world reconstruction of unseen objects without category-specific training.
techniques.summary_verbatim: TouchAnything is a framework that leverages a pretrained large-scale 2D vision diffusion model as a semantic and geometric prior for 3D reconstruction from sparse tactile measurements.
mechanism_atoms: Leverages a pretrained large-scale 2D vision diffusion model as a semantic and geometric prior to reconstruct accurate 3D geometry from only a few sparse tactile measurements, enabling open-world reconstruction of unseen objects without category-specific training.

techniques.name: FG-CLTP: Fine-Grained Contrastive Language Tactile Pretraining for Robotic Manipulation
techniques.capability_it_enables: Tactile-language pretraining over 100k+ tactile 3D point-cloud/language pairs capturing quantitative contact states (force magnitude, contact geometry, principal-axis orientation) via discretized numerical tokenization; provides a sensor-agnostic foundation for 3D tactile-language-action models with a flow-matching policy.
techniques.summary_verbatim: FG-CLTP is a fine-grained contrastive language tactile pretraining framework that includes a novel dataset comprising over 100k tactile 3D point cloud-language pairs that explicitly capture multidimensional contact states from the sensor's perspective.
mechanism_atoms: Tactile-language pretraining over 100k+ tactile 3D point-cloud/language pairs capturing quantitative contact states (force magnitude, contact geometry, principal-axis orientation) via discretized numerical tokenization; provides a sensor-agnostic foundation for 3D tactile-language-action models with a flow-matching policy.

techniques.name: Visuo-Tactile World Models (VT-WM)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Multi-task visuo-tactile world model that captures the physics of contact through touch reasoning, complementing vision with tactile images to handle occlusion and ambiguous contact; reports 33% better object-permanence and up to 35% higher zero-shot real-robot success on contact-rich tasks.
techniques.summary_verbatim: VT-WM captures the physics of contact through touch reasoning, and by complementing vision with tactile images, it better understands robot-object interactions in contact-rich tasks, avoiding common failure modes of vision-only models under occlusion or ambiguous contact states.
mechanism_atoms: Multi-task visuo-tactile world model that captures the physics of contact through touch reasoning, complementing vision with tactile images to handle occlusion and ambiguous contact; reports 33% better object-permanence and up to 35% higher zero-shot real-robot success on contact-rich tasks.

techniques.name: AROMMA: Unifying Olfactory Embeddings for Single Molecules and Mixtures
techniques.capability_it_enables: Unified olfactory embedding space for single molecules and two-molecule mixtures: each molecule encoded by a chemical foundation model, mixtures composed by a permutation-invariant attention aggregator, with odor-descriptor alignment via knowledge distillation and class-aware pseudo-labeling; up to 19.1% AUROC improvement.
techniques.summary_verbatim: AROMMA is a framework that learns a unified embedding space for single molecules and two-molecule mixtures, where each molecule is encoded by a chemical foundation model and the mixtures are composed by an attention-based aggregator, ensuring both permutation invariance and asymmetric molecular interactions.
mechanism_atoms: Unified olfactory embedding space for single molecules and two-molecule mixtures: each molecule encoded by a chemical foundation model, mixtures composed by a permutation-invariant attention aggregator, with odor-descriptor alignment via knowledge distillation and class-aware pseudo-labeling; up to 19.1% AUROC improvement.

techniques.name: NOSE: Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding with Tri-Modal Orthogonal Contrastive Learning
techniques.capability_it_enables: Representation-learning framework aligning three modalities of the olfactory pathway (molecular structure, receptor sequence, natural-language description) and decoupling their contributions via orthogonal constraints; uses an LLM to mine weak positive descriptor samples.
techniques.summary_verbatim: NOSE (Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding) is a representation learning framework that aligns three modalities along the olfactory pathway: molecular structure, receptor sequence, and natural language description.
mechanism_atoms: Representation-learning framework aligning three modalities of the olfactory pathway (molecular structure, receptor sequence, natural-language description) and decoupling their contributions via orthogonal constraints; uses an LLM to mine weak positive descriptor samples.

techniques.name: kooplearn (Scikit-Learn Compatible Library for Evolution Operator Learning)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Unified scikit-learn-compatible library to learn Koopman/Transfer operators and infinitesimal generators from data via linear, kernel, and deep-learning (neural-network Koopman embedding) estimators with spectral decomposition; enables data-driven forecasting of nonlinear dynamics
techniques.summary_verbatim: kooplearn is a Python library to learn evolution operators — also known as Koopman or Transfer operators — from data. It is easy to use and strictly adheres to the scikit-learn API.
mechanism_atoms: Unified scikit-learn-compatible library to learn Koopman/Transfer operators and infinitesimal generators from data via linear, kernel, and deep-learning (neural-network Koopman embedding) estimators with spectral decomposition; enables data-driven forecasting of nonlinear dynamics

techniques.name: MASF: Measurement-Aware Score-based Filter (Rethinking Forward Processes for Score-Based Data Assimilation in High Dimensions)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Score-based filter for high-dimensional nonlinear data assimilation/state estimation that builds a measurement-aware forward process directly from the measurement equation, giving an analytically tractable (exact for linear) likelihood score and lower compute than ensemble Kalman filters
techniques.summary_verbatim: MASF defines a measurement-aware forward process directly from the measurement equation, which is exact for linear measurement operators and provides a principled approximation for nonlinear operators.
mechanism_atoms: Score-based filter for high-dimensional nonlinear data assimilation/state estimation that builds a measurement-aware forward process directly from the measurement equation, giving an analytically tractable (exact for linear) likelihood score and lower compute than ensemble Kalman filters

techniques.name: Score Filter Enhanced Data Assimilation Framework for Data-Driven Dynamical Systems (EnSF hybrid DA-training)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Hybrid data-assimilation + ML-training framework using the training-free Ensemble Score Filter (a diffusion-model DA approach) to reduce predictive uncertainty and improve long-term forecasting of high-dimensional nonlinear data-driven dynamical systems
techniques.summary_verbatim: It applies the Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF), a generative AI-based training-free diffusion model approach, for solving the data assimilation problem in high-dimensional nonlinear complex systems.
mechanism_atoms: Hybrid data-assimilation + ML-training framework using the training-free Ensemble Score Filter (a diffusion-model DA approach) to reduce predictive uncertainty and improve long-term forecasting of high-dimensional nonlinear data-driven dynamical systems

techniques.name: Inverse problems with diffusion models: MAP estimation via mode-seeking loss (VML)
techniques.capability_it_enables: Zero-shot / plug-and-play solving of arbitrary (linear and nonlinear) inverse problems using a pre-trained unconditional diffusion model, via a variational mode-seeking loss whose per-step minimization steers samples toward the MAP estimate (analytic for linear inverse problems)
techniques.summary_verbatim: The paper introduces the variational mode-seeking loss (VML) and shows that its minimization at each reverse diffusion step guides the generated sample towards the MAP estimate.
mechanism_atoms: Zero-shot / plug-and-play solving of arbitrary (linear and nonlinear) inverse problems using a pre-trained unconditional diffusion model, via a variational mode-seeking loss whose per-step minimization steers samples toward the MAP estimate (analytic for linear inverse problems)

techniques.name: FlowDA: Accurate, Low-Latency Weather Data Assimilation via Flow Matching
techniques.capability_it_enables: Flow-matching (score/diffusion-adjacent generative) approach to weather-scale data assimilation / atmospheric state estimation with low latency
techniques.summary_verbatim: FlowDA: Accurate, Low-Latency Weather Data Assimilation via Flow Matching
